status: THE MASSLESS SPIN CONTENT AND THE DISPERSION OF THE STEP (F4). The step factorises exactly as M(q) = kron(P(q), U16^6) (4.9e-15), so any cubic symmetry acts on the 8-dimensional bond factor alone and the internal 16 is inert. But the ordered six-stage sequence is NOT cubic-covariant: the intertwiner is exact for only 16 of the 48 signed permutations (element orders [1, 2, 4], best residual 0.0e+00) - the step's own point group is that subgroup of index 3, not O_h: the axial reflections and the (0 2) transposition survive, the cyclic axis permutations do not. Census: over the 15^3 zone grid the smallest quasi-energy is 0.000e+00 lattice units and at the 12 M nodes it lies in [0.000e+00, 2.220e-16] - at the clock the would-be massless matter is NOT lifted: Gamma is fully pinned to the Floquet pair (64+64 levels at {0, pi}) and the 12 M channels are exactly gapless (Proposition 2, V203) - but the pinned pair is not a propagating cone and carries no spin (F4 clause 1, clock re-timing). The little group of an M node is C2v (order 4, element orders [1, 2]) and its representation on the near-gapless bond subspace has largest character 1.000: NO 2-dimensional irrep, hence no helicity +/-1 or +/-2 pair and no massless spin-2 candidate at all (F4 clause 2 has nothing to apply to). The dispersion of the lowest branch is linear but anisotropic, v in [0.0000, 0.5774], anisotropy 1.000 (F4 clause 3: c = 1 fails). VERDICT: all three clauses of F4 are realised in the implemented step. The graviton is not in this one-particle spectrum: the classical GR limit claimed in Section 9 is a statement about the coarse-grained geometry, and F4 must be read as a requirement on a sector the implementation does not yet contain.
